summary: Frontend-only test of v1.7.1 drag & drop add and the rating source tag, run against the preview URL with a fake electronAPI. New suite /app/tests/test_iter45_drop_rating.py: run_drop_main 21/21, run_drop_edges 10/10, run_rating_tag 22/22. Regression run_fix_manual 44/44 (new rating_source assertions added; Wikidata mock and toast assertion updated, see below). Regression iter37 run_add_files: Add Files still opens the file dialog with the 'Choose files' button, the Breaking Bad merge groups, stored cats/filter/stats are fine, no page errors. No functional bugs found.

issues: rating-source-tag-full uses the same 9px text as the card tag next to a ~16px star rating. 'IMDb via Wikidata' is hard to read in the detail window; 10-11px would read better there (the card size is fine).

verified: dragover with types ['Files'] calls preventDefault, sets dropEffect 'copy' and shows library-drop-overlay ('Drop video files or a folder to add them'). dragleave hides it. A non-file drag (text/plain) is ignored.

Drop of [file, folder, duplicate file, file inside the folder]: the folder is scanned with scanForVideos(path, false) and files are never scanned. The nested Sub\Nested.mkv is not added and duplicates are removed. The dialog says 'Choose the type for the 2 dropped items.' and 'Add to library' stays disabled until a type is picked.
Picking Movies: 2 cards added, openFileDialog not called, toast 'Added 2 movies to library', dir_categories saved for D:\Drop and D:\Drop\Folder.
Re-dropping an existing path: dialog says '1 dropped item.', toast 'already in your library', count unchanged.
Dropping an empty folder plus a .txt shows the toast 'No video files found in what you dropped' and no dialog. Uppercase .MP4 and .ts are accepted.
Cancel and Escape after a drop add nothing. Afterwards More > Add individual files shows the default description and 'Choose files', with the type picker reset.
Dropping a file into an already-scanned dir (M:\Movies) keeps that dir's type; no new category entry.
Free tier with 499 cards + 3 dropped: only 1 added, warning 'only adding 1 of 3 movies.'
Card tags: IMDb / MC / RT / WD / Critics with the tooltip '<Source> rating via Wikidata' (legacy wikidata: 'Rating from Wikidata'). No tag for null or absent source, or when rating is 0 or null.

Detail window shows 'IMDb via Wikidata' and 'Rotten Tomatoes via Wikidata'. Editing the rating with the confirm button or Enter saves the rating, sets rating_source to null and removes the tag from both the detail and the card. No tag on TMDB or rating-0 details.
fixMissingInfo stores rating_source: matrix=IMDb, imdb=Metacritic, rt=Rotten Tomatoes, tv=IMDb, wiki (title search)=IMDb. Titles whose rating came from TMDB (heat/sf/second/parts/match) get null.
action_items: Optional: in the manual-match fallback (LocalLibraryPage.jsx ~line 663, the `d ? ... : { poster_path, tmdb_id, overview, rating: result.rating, ... }` branch when the details fetch fails), add rating_source: null. Otherwise an old Wikidata tag stays next to a TMDB rating.

Optional: make the will-navigate check stricter. /index\.html/i matches any file:// URL containing 'index.html' (e.g. a dropped file named 'index.html.mp4'). Compare against the app's own loadFile URL instead.

Optional: the drop-dialog count includes paths already in the library ('2 dropped items' when 1 is a duplicate), and the duplicate toast for drops says 'Selected files are already in your library'. Consider filtering known paths before showing the dialog and using drop-specific wording.
critical_code_review_comments: Drop handlers rely on File.path, which is fine on electron 28.0.0 (package.json). If Electron is upgraded to 32 or later, File.path is removed and webUtils.getPathForFile must be exposed through preload.

fetchDetailsForMovie (~line 637) sets keep.rating = d.rating only when the card had no rating. A leftover source is unlikely there, but setting keep.rating_source = null alongside it would be consistent.
Folders are scanned one after another in onLibraryDrop. This is fine for a few folders; consider a spinner or toast for slow network shares, because nothing is shown until scanning finishes.
updated_files: /app/tests/test_iter44_fix_missing.py (WdMock.handle_api now reads srsearch and returns query.search; the Q11 row has a label; the title-search mock drops non-film hits like the real haswbstatement filter; the toast assertion now matches 'Filled X ratings, Y years, Z genres'; rating_source assertions added)
seed_data_creation: None. All data is in isolated browser contexts (sessionStorage/localStorage fake library).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: g={'page':page}; exec(open('/app/tests/test_iter45_drop_rating.py').read(), g); await g['run_drop_main'](); await g['run_drop_edges'](); await g['run_rating_tag'](). Drops are simulated with a plain Event carrying a dataTransfer {types, files:[{path}]} dispatched on [data-testid=library-drop-zone]. SCAN_SPY records scanForVideos args and honours recursive=false. The iter44 WdMock now supports the list=search API (srsearch).
